question: Can a bus-powered UCC27517DBVR drive the AO3400A candidate after source disconnection without relying on battery AUX3V3?
method: Datasheet supply, UVLO, output voltage and pin review; resistor-limited DC gate budget only
stop_condition: Evaluate startup margin and source-shunt gate budget once; save pin-level candidate and unresolved comparator/cold-start conditions
limitations: No time-domain startup or SOA verification
Source shunt value is a candidate, not tolerance-qualified
No extrapolation of 12 V switching timing to 5 V
Comparator and reference supply must also survive upstream power removal
